name: Diplomatic Incident
summary: Two Earthen Ring dignitaries have gone missing in Silverpine Forest while traveling to Tarren Mill. Danitha sends you to Trevan Rol at the Sepulcher to learn more and help secure the Horde’s legitimacy.

sections.title: Missing Travelers
sections.body: Danitha sends you to Trevan Rol at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Two Earthen Ring dignitaries vanished while traveling toward Tarren Mill, and little is known beyond rumors of a diplomatic incident. Their recovery could help the Horde gain legitimacy. Trevan says you have walked into a serious mess.

faq.answer: Two dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest while traveling to Tarren Mill.

faq.q: Where do I go for information?
faq.answer: Danitha sends you to speak with Trevan Rol at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why does Danitha want the travelers found?
faq.answer: Recovering the missing Earthen Ring dignitaries could help the Horde gain legitimacy.
They went missing in Silverpine Forest while traveling toward Tarren Mill. Their whereabouts are unknown.
